placements.why: The envelope describes an internal HR/operations mechanism (a new-hire onboarding checklist) — a category of organizational self-governance that nothing in the currently empty strata covers, and the ratified strata vocabulary names 'Organization' as exactly this bucket.
placements.title: the org's internal operations and people-processes
placements.frame: does this content describe how the organization runs its own internal, people-facing processes (roles, onboarding, structure) rather than product, market, or architecture work?

placements.title: onboarding formalized into a fixed, repeatable checklist
placements.frame: does this expression describe the checklist's required components, its universal application to new hires, or its evolution/supersession of prior onboarding artifacts?
placements.why: Both segments describe the same recurring organizational subject — a named checklist (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) that every new hire completes, and its formal replacement of an older wiki-based process last quarter. This is a subject future onboarding-related envelopes will keep feeding (the checklist's contents, adoption, revisions), not a one-time measurement or isolated event, so it clears the narrative grain test rather than being folded as a bare fact under some other theme.
